body:
OK I realized this might be what `Field.Validity` is actually for
```jsx
<Field.Validity>
  {validityState => ['patternMismatch', 'tooShort'].some(state => {
    Object.entries(validity.validity)
      .map((entry) => (entry[1] ? entry[0] : null))
      .filter((v) => v)
      .includes(state)) ? null : <Field.Error />
  }}
<Field.Validity/>
```
But still feels a bit indirect to have to do it this way 🤔
Just noticed Radix supports a `match` function: https://www.radix-ui.com/primitives/docs/components/form#custom-validation
